entities.summary: George Francis Scott-Elliot FRGS FLS FRSE (1862–1934) was a botanist and academic author of Franco-Scots descent. He was a personal friend of Patrick Geddes. The standard author abbreviation Scott Elliot is used to indicate this person as the author when citing a botanical name.
